Race Registration Launch Timeline
January-March 2027 Races
Please note: All information is subject to change.
January-March 2027 races will open for registration at 12:00 p.m. ET on the following dates:
Wednesday, October 14: Advance registration for adult races opens to all members. Registration to youth races opens to the public.
Friday, October 16: General registration opens to the public for adult races.
Please note: 9+1 credit only applies to 9+1 Passholders. 9+1 program credit at eligible races is available only to registered 2027 9+1 Passholders.
